text:
elaine: Quick question — should the console surface per-route notify budget alongside routing weight? worried folks will tweak weights and accidentally blow through tenant notify quotas.

nick: I think yes, but we need a clear mental model. show both: routing weight (affects selection) and notify budget (how many alerts that route will cost). otherwise it’s opaque. :thinking:

sara: can we reuse notify-preview or does this need a dedicated estimate endpoint that composes routing + quota + quiet-windows? mixing UI preview and backend estimate might be confusing.

ben: prefer dedicated endpoint. propose /v2/notify/estimate with payload like:
```
{
  "route_id": "string",
  "routing_weight": 0.25,
  "window_minutes": 60,
  "tenant_id": "string"
}
```
returns { estimated_alerts_per_hour, p50, p95, quota_impact, assumptions }. keeps notify-preview focused on rendering.

elaine: also want the console to show a "failover" column: if primary route is saturated, which fallback route fires and what additional quota it will consume. helps SREs reason about multi-tier policies.

nick: UX question — should failover policies be implicit (only surface when non-default fallback exists) or explicit per-route toggle? i vote explicit so customers aren’t surprised. :thumbsup:

sara: telemetry note — we should emit notify_estimate_requests and estimate_accuracy_histogram (compare estimate -> actual over time). Without metrics, we won't know if estimator assumptions are off.

ops-bot: deploy-bot merged branch feature/notify-estimator. CI passed, canary scheduled for 02:30 UTC.

elaine: small nit — return percentiles (p50/p95) rather than a single number; helps set threshold budgets in the console. also include an "assumptions" string array: e.g., ["batching: 64", "kv_cache_hit: 0.8"].

ben: agree. and include an optional param to simulate "quiet window" suppression so PMs can preview impact.

nick: i'll draft internal API docs + console mock tomorrow. can someone own adding the telemetry events? sara?

sara: happy to own telemetry. i'll add estimate vs actual alerts dashboard and an alert if mismatch > 50% for >3h.

elaine: perfect. once we have the API shape, we can wire the console to show routing weight, estimated p95 alerts/hour, quota impact, failover target, and a little info icon with assumptions.

ben: one more: add rate-limit on estimator endpoint (per-tenant) so customers don't spam it from the UI. maybe 30/min default.

nick: noted. thanks all. moving to RFC PR after mock.:rocket:
